newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market, brokers said on Tuesday.

They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly on some technical buying prompted by the yen's weaker tendency against the U.S. dollar and improved technical factors but this had little impact on the market here.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due to a lack of fresh incentives. But prices turned mixed in the afternoon on some light local buying and selling interest amid uncertainty over market direction," a local broker said.

"Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly today but there was no follow-through buying interest here. The lack of Chinese enquiries and quiet ring session also limited market activity," another local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, February RSS3 rose 0.25 cent to 122.25 U.S. cents a kg.
February RSS1 fell one cent to 172.75 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg.
February TSR20 rose 1.25 cents to 169.50 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
